CategorySettings.description: Per-category dials. A bare level stands for `{ severity = <level> }`.

max_per_100_words.description: Density budget; above it the category fails even with no error finding. The string none clears a budget that a lower layer set, so the category has no budget.

minimum_severity.description: Lowest level that inherited rules in this category may report at. `off` means no floor, and it cancels a floor set in a lower layer.

weight.description: Multiplier on this category's share of the score. 0 makes it informational.

FrontmatterPolicy.description: Which fields of a document's `slopvac:` block take effect. A block field outside the allowed set is an error at its line and column.

enabled.description: When false, `slopvac:` is plain data and is not read.

GenreBlock.description: Assigns a genre to the files it matches and patches their settings. Genre definitions live in genre files.

Glob.description: A gitignore-style pattern, matched against the path relative to the directory of the nearest config, the one that applies to the file, even when an extended file holds the pattern. A leading `!` negates. The last matching pattern wins.

Guidance.description: Agent steering. Project-wide: overrides, genre blocks and front matter cannot set it.

IndexConfig.description: Which plugin indexes `slopvac plugins search` reads. Project-scoped: no user config, environment variable, front matter or override sets it. Naming an index grants it no trust. Semantics: docs/contract/plugin-index.md, sections 5 and 6.

default.description: Read the signed first-party index, named `slopvac`.

extra.description: Extra unsigned indexes, at most 16, read in this order after the default index. Each `name` appears once; the config validator checks that, because JSON Schema cannot.

IndexExtra.description: An extra plugin index. Search results say `listed by <name>`. Its publisher keys are for display only.

IndexExtraSource.description: Where to fetch an extra index: an `oci://` reference or an `https://` URL. The URL carries no user-info. `http://`, `git+https://` and path sources are invalid.

IndexName.description: The name of an extra index: a plugin-id-shaped slug. `core` is reserved for the built-in plugin and `slopvac` names the default index.

Locale.description: Spelling target. `und` disables the spelling check.

Network.description: Network policy. `offline = true` is sticky: no other source can unset it, so `false` only restates the default. See docs/contract/policies.md.

Override.description: A glob-scoped patch. Every matching block applies in file order and the last writer of a field wins.

Profile.description: A built-in strictness tier, as a name or as a table that adds a severity shift. A profile sets gate thresholds and shifts severities, and nothing else.

severity_shift.description: Steps to move the inherited severity of each rule along suggestion, warning, error. Inherited means the level from rule definitions, styles and the genre chain. Positive is stricter. A level that a rules or categories entry sets is final and does not move. `off` never moves, and results clamp at the ends.

Ref.description: A style or genre name. A bare name resolves against the active plugins and must be unambiguous; `<plugin>:<name>` is exact.

Review.description: Agent review. The provider is a trusted plugin; it stays idle during lint.

author_model.description: Model name of the author. The review refuses a reviewer with the same name.

model.description: Model name the reviewer must report.

provider.description: Plugin id of the model provider.

RuleKey.description: A rule or category name: qualified `<plugin>:<id>` or a bare name that is unambiguous across the active plugins. Keys of maps in this file are data, so the `x-` convention does not apply to them.

RuleLevel.description: The level a rule or category reports at. `off` disables it.

Settings.description: Settings that a layer below the project config, an override, a genre block and front matter can all set. Each layer patches the one below field by field. Maps merge by key. Lists and scalars replace.

Source.description: A data plugin or code plugin the project depends on. The lockfile pins the digest and records the kind.

source.description: An `oci://` reference, a `git+https://` URL with a commit, or a path relative to the config file.

allow.description: Words this project spells or uses its own way. The spelling check and identifier checks skip them.

blocklists.description: Word blocklist files, relative to the config file. Each entry names a word, a part of speech and a reason.

files.description: Terms files, relative to the config file.

Thresholds.description: Document-level gates, evaluated after every finding is collected.

max_total_per_100_words.description: Severity-weighted error and warning density per 100 words; errors count 1.0 and warnings 0.5.

max_unicode_dashes.description: Ceiling on Unicode em and en dashes in the source.

description: Project config. Unknown keys are errors; keys that start with `x-` are ignored. Semantics: docs/contract/config.md.

extends.description: Config files merged below this one, lowest first. A path relative to this file or `<plugin>:<name>` for a plugin config.

plugins.description: Data plugins and code plugins the project uses, in one list. Each id appears once, and `core` is reserved for the built-in plugin. A code plugin also needs `slopvac plugins trust`; one that is not trusted never starts.

styles.description: Ordered style presets. The last listed wins.
